name: backdoor/attach-policy
description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an existing IAM user or role via Glue job

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach policy to (auto-detects type from ARN, tries both if plain name)

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: Policy ARN to attach (defaults to AdministratorAccess)
